updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: Entra Global Secure Access Integration Generally Available
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to enforce data protection policies at the network layer across browsers, apps, APIs, and generative AI platforms. This allows admins to prevent sensitive data exfiltration to untrusted cloud apps and correlate risky user activity detected through Insider Risk Management with network-level enforcement.

updates.title: CVE-2026-77903: Microsoft Dataverse Authentication Bypass Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability through spoofing in Microsoft Dataverse allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. Admins should apply security updates immediately to prevent unauthorized access to Dataverse resources.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69843: Microsoft Fabric Authentication Bypass Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability through spoofing in Microsoft Fabric enables unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. Organizations relying on Fabric should prioritize patching to prevent unauthorized access and privilege escalation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-85889: Azure AI Foundry Missing Authentication Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: A missing authentication vulnerability for a critical function in Azure AI Foundry allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. Admins should apply patches to ensure only authenticated users can access critical AI Foundry operations.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69865: Microsoft Container Registry Authorization Bypass Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An authorization bypass vulnerability through user-controlled keys in Microsoft Container Registry allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. Container administrators should apply patches to restrict privilege escalation risks.

updates.title: CVE-2026-85878: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Authorization Bypass Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An improper authorization vulnerability in Azure Database for PostgreSQL allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges over a network. Database administrators should apply updates to enforce proper authorization controls.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Adaptive Protection Integration
updates.summary: Purview's Adaptive Protection now integrates with Data Lifecycle Management to automatically apply retention labels based on users' insider risk levels, enabling dynamic preservation of deleted emails and files. This allows compliance teams to automatically govern data retention in response to changing user risk profiles without manual intervention.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations: Endpoint DLP Alert Analysis
updates.summary: Data Security Investigations now integrates with endpoint DLP alerts, allowing admins to automatically gather and review files that triggered alerts rather than manually investigating exfiltration events. This accelerates incident response by correlating endpoint DLP detections with file content analysis.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: Non-Microsoft Connected Apps Support
updates.summary: DLP policies now protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft cloud applications such as Box and Google Workspace using existing Defender for Cloud Apps connectors. Admins can extend the same classification engine and sensitive information types used in Microsoft 365 to third-party SaaS platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Priority Cleanup for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: A new Priority Cleanup feature allows admins to permanently delete selected SharePoint and OneDrive files after simulation, review, and approvals, bypassing the recycle bin and removing discoverability from search. This provides compliance teams a streamlined method to permanently dispose of sensitive or regulated content at scale.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Automatic Deletion for Inactive OneDrive and Mailboxes
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management now enables admins to automatically delete both content and containers for departed users, helping maintain regulatory compliance without manual intervention. This reduces the administrative burden of offboarding and ensures inactive resources are removed per retention policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: In-Product Diagnostics for Troubleshooting
updates.summary: eDiscovery now includes self-service diagnostics that identify common configuration issues such as case permissions, security filters, and policy misconfigurations with remediation guidance. This allows eDiscovery admins to resolve common issues without escalating to support.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Information Protection: Auto-Labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report
updates.summary: Admins can now view per-policy coverage reports showing which files have been labeled or remain unlabeled during enforcement, compared against the latest simulation snapshot. This provides visibility into auto-labeling enforcement progress and identifies files processed during enforcement that were not captured in simulations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Endpoint Temporary File Noise Reduction
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now reduces noise from temporary files automatically created and deleted by Windows, Office applications, and browsers during normal operations. Enhanced exclusion patterns help admins focus on genuine suspicious file activity without over-excluding valid security signals.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: Island Enterprise Browser Integration
updates.summary: Purview DLP now integrates with Island's enterprise browser to detect and protect data shared with unmanaged cloud applications at the point of user interaction. Admins can apply the same classifiers and sensitivity labels used in Purview policies to browser-based workflows via HTTP and HTTPS.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management: Copilot Readiness Assessment
updates.summary: Purview DSPM introduces Copilot readiness capabilities and data explorer experiences to help security teams assess and improve organizational data readiness for Microsoft Copilot. The feature consolidates insights on sensitive data exposure, oversharing, and protection coverage to prioritize remediation efforts.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Sensitive Data Insights and Policy Recommendations
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management now provides insights on sensitive data in OneDrive and SharePoint with recommendations for retention policies to improve data security and compliance posture. Admins can leverage these insights to better govern sensitive data without manual discovery.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Teams Retention Policy Scope Change for Copilot
updates.summary: Legacy Teams retention policies that currently apply to both Teams and Copilot interactions will be converted to Teams-only policies, ending implicit governance of Copilot workloads. Admins should review existing policies to ensure Copilot governance is explicitly configured if needed.

updates.title: CVE-2026-68791: Azure Machine Learning Incorrect Authorization Information Disclosure
updates.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Azure Machine Learning allows unauthorized attackers to disclose sensitive information over a network. Admins should apply security updates to enforce proper access controls.
